Message:
[PATCH] sound: hda: detect ALC883 on MSI K9A Platinum motherboards (MS-7280)

Recognize the Realtek ALC883 chip on MSI K9A Platinum motherboards
(model no. MS-7280), enabling full sound capabilities.
